uncited: *   **Complexity:** The method requires rendering the focus structure exclusively and the full candidate, plus pixel-wise operations.
*   **Limitations:** It is dependent on the definition of a "focus structure." It does not evaluate the overall quality of the volume rendering, only the coherence of a specific part.
The Coherence Metric was introduced in the context of Visibility-Aware Direct Volume Rendering to help users generate clear and comprehensible volume rendering images.
